concerns.text: The plan marks FR‑013 as **Not satisfied** and states that no verified open‑access EDS dataset exists, yet the specification (FR‑013) explicitly requires using the verified dataset “Doe et al., 2023, Open Perovskite EDS Repository”. This violates the functional requirement and means the primary spatial‑correlation predictor data is missing, rendering the core research question unanswerable as written.
